``` ## Attributes - `colspan`, `rowspan` – merge cells - `` – title for accessibility - `` – clearer for screen readers ## Accessibility Basics - Use semantic elements - `alt` on images - `aria-label` when no text visible - Keyboard-navigable forms - Colour contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1 ## Edge Cases - Tables must not be used for layout - Nested tables hurt accessibility - `aria-*` should not replace semantics ## Interview FAQs **Q1: Why avoid tables for layout?** Semantically wrong, not responsive, hurts a11y. **Q2: What is `scope` in a table header?** Tells screen readers whether header applies to column or row. **Q3: What is ARIA?** Accessible Rich Internet Applications – attributes for a11y.

topics.title: CSS Selectors, Box Model & Flexbox/Grid
topics.contentMd:
# CSS3 Fundamentals

## Selectors
- Element: `p`
- Class: `.btn`
- ID: `#header`
- Attribute: `input[type="text"]`
- Pseudo: `:hover`, `:nth-child(2)`, `::before`

## Box Model
```
content → padding → border → margin
```
Use `box-sizing: border-box;` so width includes padding + border.

## Display
- block, inline, inline-block, flex, grid, none

## Flexbox
```css
.container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}
```

## Grid
```css
.grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
}
```

## Positioning
- static, relative, absolute, fixed, sticky

## Edge Cases
- Margin collapse between adjacent blocks
- `z-index` only works on positioned elements
- 100vh mobile bug – use dvh or JS fix

## Interview FAQs
**Q1: Flexbox vs Grid?**
Flex for 1D layout; Grid for 2D layout.

**Q2: What is box-sizing?**
How width/height are calculated relative to padding and border.

**Q3: How does z-index work?**
Stacking order among positioned elements with a stacking context.

topics.title: Responsive Design, Media Queries & Variables
topics.contentMd:
# Responsive Design

## Media Queries
```css
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .container { flex-direction: column; }
}
```

## Mobile-First
Start with mobile styles, then layer up with min-width.

## Units
- px – fixed
- % – relative to parent
- em – relative to parent font
- rem – relative to root font
- vw/vh – viewport

## CSS Variables
```css
:root {
  --primary: #2563eb;
  --radius: 8px;
}
.btn { background: var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius); }
```

## Images
```css
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
```

## Edge Cases
- Fixed widths break small screens
- Too many breakpoints → maintenance pain
- Test on real devices

## Interview FAQs
**Q1: Mobile-first vs desktop-first?**
Mobile-first improves performance and forces prioritization.

**Q2: Why rem over px?**
Better for accessibility and scaling.

**Q3: How to make images responsive?**
max-width 100%, height auto.

topics.title: Variables, Data Types, Operators & Control Flow
Functions, Arrays, Objects & ES6+
topics.contentMd:
# Functions & ES6+

## Functions
```js
function add(a, b) { return a + b; }
const mul = (a, b) => a * b;
const greet = (name = "Guest") => `Hi ${name}`;
```

## Array Methods
```js
arr.map(x => x * 2)
arr.filter(x => x > 0)
arr.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
arr.find(x => x === 3)
arr.some(x => x > 5)
arr.every(x => x > 0)
arr.sort((a, b) => a - b)
```

## Object Utilities
```js
const { a, b } = obj;
const merged = { ...obj1, ...obj2 };
Object.keys(obj); Object.values(obj); Object.entries(obj);
```

## Template Literals
```js
console.log(`${name} is ${age}`);
```

## Destructuring & Spread
```js
const [first, ...rest] = [1, 2, 3];
function sum(...nums) { return nums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); }
```

## Edge Cases
- Arrow functions do not have their own `this`
- `sort()` mutates the original array
- `map` returns new array; `forEach` returns undefined

## Interview FAQs
**Q1: map vs forEach?**
map returns a new array; forEach returns undefined.

**Q2: What is destructuring?**
Extracting values from arrays/objects into variables.

**Q3: What is the spread operator?**
Expands iterable into individual elements.

topics.title: Selecting, Creating & Modifying DOM Elements
topics.contentMd: # DOM Manipulation ## Selecting Elements ```js document.getElementById("id") document.querySelector(".btn") document.querySelectorAll(".card") ``` ## Modifying ```js el.textContent = "Hi"; el.innerHTML = "Hi"; el.style.color = "red"; el.classList.add("active"); el.classList.toggle("hidden"); el.setAttribute("data-id", 10); ``` ## Creating & Inserting ```js const div = document.createElement("div"); div.textContent = "New"; parent.appendChild(div); parent.insertBefore(div, parent.firstChild); parent.removeChild(div); ``` ## Traversal - `parentElement`, `children`, `nextElementSibling`, `previousElementSibling` ## Edge Cases - `querySelectorAll` returns NodeList (not array) – use `[...list]` - `innerHTML` with user data risks XSS - Frequent DOM updates are slow – use DocumentFragment ## Interview FAQs **Q1: textContent vs innerHTML?** textContent is safe; innerHTML parses HTML and risks XSS. **Q2: How to improve DOM performance?** Batch updates, use DocumentFragment, minimize reflows. **Q3: How to remove all children?** `el.replaceChildren()` or loop removeChild.

topics.title: Events – Listeners, Bubbling & Delegation
topics.contentMd:
# Events

## Adding Listeners
```js
btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  console.log(e.target);
});
```

## Common Events
- Mouse: click, dblclick, mouseover, mouseout
- Keyboard: keydown, keyup
- Form: submit, change, input, focus, blur
- Document: DOMContentLoaded, load

## Event Object
- `e.target` – element that fired
- `e.currentTarget` – element with listener
- `e.preventDefault()`
- `e.stopPropagation()`

## Bubbling & Capturing
By default events bubble from target up to document. Use the third arg of addEventListener to capture.

## Event Delegation
Attach one listener to a parent to handle many children – efficient for dynamic lists.

```js
table.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if (e.target.matches(".delete-btn")) {
    e.target.closest("tr").remove();
  }
});
```

## Edge Cases
- Removing element does not remove its listeners automatically
- `preventDefault` does not stop bubbling
- `stopPropagation` can break other listeners

## Interview FAQs
**Q1: What is event delegation?**
Using one parent listener for many dynamic children.

**Q2: Bubbling vs capturing?**
Bubbling goes up; capturing goes down.

**Q3: Why is delegation useful for dynamic tables?**
New rows are automatically handled without reattaching listeners.

topics.title: AJAX with jQuery $.ajax, $.get, $.post
topics.contentMd:
# AJAX with jQuery

## What is AJAX?
Asynchronous JavaScript And XML – fetch data from a server without reloading the page. Modern usage typically JSON.

## Basic GET
```js
$.ajax({
  url: "/api/users",
  method: "GET",
  dataType: "json",
  success: function (data) { console.log(data); },
  error: function (xhr, status, err) { console.error(err); },
  complete: function () { console.log("done"); }
});
```

## Shortcuts
```js
$.get("/api/users", function (data) { ... });
$.post("/api/users", { name: "Alice" }, function (res) { ... });
$.getJSON("/api/users", function (data) { ... });
```

## Sending JSON
```js
$.ajax({
  url: "/api/users",
  method: "POST",
  contentType: "application/json",
  data: JSON.stringify({ name: "Alice", age: 25 }),
  success: res => console.log(res)
});
```

## Error Handling
- status 400 – Bad request
- 401 – Unauthorized
- 403 – Forbidden
- 404 – Not found
- 500 – Server error

## Edge Cases
- CORS must be enabled server-side
- Always check `xhr.status`
- `dataType` mismatch causes parse errors
- Never trust client data

## Interview FAQs
**Q1: AJAX vs fetch?**
fetch is native, promise-based; AJAX is jQuery-specific.

**Q2: What is CORS?**
Cross-Origin Resource Sharing – server policy to allow cross-domain requests.

**Q3: GET vs POST?**
GET fetches data; POST sends data in the request body.

# Bootstrap JS Components ## Modal ```html

``` ## Modal via JS ```js const myModal = new bootstrap.Modal("#myModal"); myModal.show(); myModal.hide(); ``` ## Navbar ```html

``` ## Other Components - Dropdown, Tooltip, Popover, Toast, Offcanvas, Carousel ## Edge Cases - Nested modals do not work well - Modals block body scroll - Tooltips need manual init in JS ## Interview FAQs **Q1: How to open a modal programmatically?** `new bootstrap.Modal('#id').show()`. **Q2: Why does a tooltip not show?** Needs `new bootstrap.Tooltip(el)`. **Q3: How to prevent body scroll with modal open?** Bootstrap adds `.modal-open` automatically.
